## Tests

<!-- Name the tests added or updated and the behavior they pin. -->

- [ ] Every behavior change has a test that failed before the fix (TDD).
- [ ] `make check` passes.
- [ ] `make e2e` passes when relevant.
- [ ] `make vuln` passes when dependencies or release paths change.

## Compatibility and security

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, private paths, or customer data are included.
- [ ] CLI/YAML changes are documented and backward compatibility is addressed.
- [ ] New files include the SPDX header.
- [ ] Security-relevant changes are described without exploit details (see SECURITY.md).
